content:
Noah P: Hi team - new hire question: I started 4/13 and there's a company holiday on 4/21. Am I eligible for holiday pay? Also my benefits card and Ramp card are both delayed. I paid for a prescription and a transit pass. Can I get reimbursed before my first paycheck?
People Ops: Welcome Noah! :tada: Holiday pay depends on payroll cutoff; if your hire was processed before the cutoff you'll get it. We'll confirm cutoff time here. For reimbursements: two options - request a virtual Ramp card (issued same day after approval) or submit receipts in Concur and request an off-cycle reimbursement via ops@redwood.com.
Noah P: I already enrolled in benefits during onboarding. If the benefits card arrives late, can prescriptions be reimbursed by benefits or do I use Concur?
Rita H: Benefits-prescription reimbursements go to benefits@redwood.com (attach Rx and explanation). For moving/onboarding expenses and transit, use Concur and email ops@redwood.com with the Concur link and manager cc. Subject: "Off-cycle reimbursement - new hire". Typical off-cycle turnaround 2-4 business days after approvals.
Finance Bot: Automated note: off-cycle requires manager + ops approvals and bank cutoff may affect same-week posting.
Noah P: Got it. If I request a virtual Ramp card now, can Ops approve immediately? I need the transit pass today.
People Ops: If you need same-day, request virtual Ramp card and tag it "urgent" in the request email. We'll prioritize manager approval + finance hold. If we cant issue same-day due to bank windows we'll fallback to off-cycle reimbursement and confirm ETA here.
Noah P: Sending the Ramp request and Concur receipts now. Thanks all!
People Ops: Action items: 1) Confirm W-4 + direct deposit are in payroll portal (affects cutoff) 2) Submit Ramp virtual card request or Concur + email ops@redwood.com 3) We'll post payroll cutoff time once payroll confirms.
Noah P: Appreciate the help :pray:
